answer: Every claim climbs the beacon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the dawn re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
